title: Trainee Civil Drafter
abstract: This is your opportunity to be trained & developed as a Civil Drafter & work with one of Australia’s leading engineering firms

content_text:
If you thrive on finding solutions to everyday challenges, are client focussed and are keen to develop a career, then this role is for you! 
For the right candidate this is an amazing opportunity to work with one of Australia’s leading professional engineering firms in an environment which encourages collaboration, communication and innovation.
The Role
We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic individual to be trained as a Civil Draftsperson using software packages such as AutoCAD, Auto TURN, Civil 3D and 12d in our Sydney office. 
The role will have you working on a number of interesting projects for high profile clients and receive mentoring throughout your traineeship.
The civil drafting traineeship runs for three years and includes on-the-job training and requires full attendance and completion of a Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Ultimo, TAFE. All TAFE training fees will be paid by TTW.
About You
It is essential that you:
- Are well presented, keen to learn and have the ability to work as part of a team;
- Have an curious mind and can apply critical thinking to problem solving;
- Have strong interpersonal and communication skills; and
- Are eager to obtain an apprenticeship and have a passion for the industry.
The Company
TTW employs over 550 staff across six offices in Australia and Asia. We are 100% locally owned and have been consulting engineers for over 65 years.
We deliver iconic and award-winning projects across Australia and the globe that pioneer engineering excellence. TTW’s vision is to forge strong relationships with our clients through the delivery of smart, innovative and efficient engineering solutions.
We value:
Collaboration | Technical Excellence | A Personal Approach | Taking Initiative
One TTW is our ethos, which encapsulates all the experienced, innovative and creative people that makes us who we are. Through a supportive and collaborative team environment, you will have the opportunity to develop your career with a company that cares about YOU.
Benefits
- Real career development opportunities
- Flexible work arrangements
- Ongoing training and development including paid study assistance
- Company paid parental leave
- A robust social calendar 
We are an Equal Opportunities Employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.
Applicants must have full Australian working rights to be considered for this role
